reasons.MODEL_UNREAD: Reading availability has not been read, so no reading can be offered. Compass asks again with the next update.
reasons.MODEL_OFF: Model calls are off for this run. Restart without --no-observer-model or its alias --no-harness-usage to allow a reading.
reasons.ROUTE_UNREAD: Who would read this session is not published, so no analysis is offered. Compass asks again with the next update.
reasons.READINGS_OFF: Model calls are paused. Nothing is sent until you resume.
reasons.STORE_BUSY: Another tab or dashboard is saving to the store of what you typed, so nothing was started or spent. Try again in a moment.
reasons.STORE_UNUSABLE: Compass could not use the file that holds what you typed, so nothing was started or spent.
reasons.POLICY_UNREADABLE: Reading permission or its daily budget could not be read or saved. Restore access to the Compass store before analyzing drift.
